bullets.text: Hollow Core Fiber Revolutionizes Testing - **Microsoft Azure** scales hollow core fiber production, promising breakthroughs in speed and efficiency.
Wi-Fi 8 Targets AI Needs - **MediaTek** previews Wi-Fi 8, focusing on reliability and efficiency for AI-driven applications.
Fiber Connectivity Fuels AI Data Centers - High-capacity fiber routes are essential for the performance of AI-ready data centers.
EXA Expands Subsea Network - **EXA Infrastructure** acquires **Aqua Comms**, enhancing its transatlantic and intra-European connectivity.
Investigation into Subsea Cable Damage - **Arelion** confirms damage to its Baltic cable, with authorities investigating the cause.
SoftBank's Strategic AI Move - **SoftBank** acquires **DigitalBridge**, reflecting shifts in telecom infrastructure due to AI demands.
Telefónica Tech Simplifies Operations - **Telefónica** transfers local operations in LatAm to **Hiberus** as part of its strategic restructuring.
Gogo Launches 5G Inflight Service - **Gogo** confirms readiness for commercial rollout of its 5G air-to-ground network in North America.
LoRaWAN Reaches Tipping Point - Adoption surpasses 125 million devices, marking a significant milestone in the IoT market.
